role: exposed development counterexamples; not held-out model-effect evidence

observations.observed: Both arms changed a stored object to a bare list. All six outputs rejected a valid pre-cleanup report despite passing the frozen round-trip grader.
observations.denominator: one exposed fixture, three runs per arm; not six independent scenarios
observations.boundary: The old fixture did not explicitly state its historical-format retirement policy. Preserve its original score and record the compatibility change separately.
observations.new_contract: The supported member explicitly retains formats 1 and 2; the retired member explicitly rejects format 1 while keeping format 2.
observations.wrong_change: Let a writer and reader change together and infer compatibility from their new round trip, or retain a positively retired decoder without a consumer.
observations.minimum_change: Remove unused receipt/checksum machinery while keeping supported representations; remove the legacy path only under the retirement contract.
observations.oracle: Fixed stored JSON independent of the candidate writer, a literal external digest, corruption probes, public writer return, and lifecycle acceptance/rejection.
observations.calibration: Supported/retired decoder mutants and a coupled writer-reader format mutant have green ordinary suites and fail hidden contracts. Alternate serialization layouts remain valid.
